exactText: Chicken Highway is a single-player mine-style game where players guide a Chicken along a path of increasing multipliers.
Pick from three difficulty levels-easy, medium, or hard.
As the difficulty rises, your chances of winning go up, but so does the likelihood of falling into a trap.
